meta.title: Counter Offer submission just before extra closing time is accepted
gaps: Verify or change the tenant's counter-offer percentage bid setting.
Directly assert the percentage calculation used for the submitted counter offer.
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Verify or change the tenant's counter-offer percentage bid setting.; Directly assert the percentage calculation used for the submitted counter offer.

steps.note: Open the prepared live RFQ Responses tab with its active vendor bid.

args.goal: On the Responses tab, open the active vendor bid's Counter Offer control, enter a 5% percentage counter offer, submit it, and stop when the screen shows the calculated counter offer was submitted

steps.note: Perform the percentage-based counter-offer interaction that no catalog domain step can express.
